Title: Physicochemical descriptors available from RDKIT
Description: Assembles 200 physicochemical descriptors from RDKit in a single pass, spanning size and weight, topological indices, polarity, hydrogen bonding capacity, lipophilicity estimates and drug-likeness measures such as QED. The particular selection follows DescriptaStorus, a curated subset that avoids the redundancy and failure-prone entries of the full RDKit list. All values are computed analytically from the structure rather than predicted, making them reproducible and inexpensive as inputs to downstream models.
Interpretation: 200 RDKit descriptors spanning constitution, topology, polarity, lipophilicity and functional group counts, computed deterministically from structure.
